english.meaning: to take something in the hand; to bring or take it along
english.note: Colloquial; 搦出去 means to take it out.

exampleSentences.english: I meant to bring you a few more books to look at today, but forgot.
exampleSentences.traditional: ei3我今日重諗住搦多幾本俾你睇𠻹，後尾唔記得咗。

exampleSentences.english: Wow, really. Those discus fish can fetch $5,000 each.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嘩，真係。搦出去賣，五千蚊一條都有啊嗰啲七彩神仙。
